name: Pressure Zone
quip: The atmosphere has become openly hostile.

name: Bounty
rules: The highest-health living player or players, if tied, takes 2 damage.

name: Scavenge
rules: Each living player draws 1 card. Each may exceed their hand limit until their turn ends.

name: Low Ammo
rules: Each player discards 1 weapon of their choice. Anyone unable to do so takes 3 damage.

name: No Cover
rules: Each player discards 1 defense card of their choice. Anyone unable to do so takes 2 damage.
quip: So much for staying out of sight.

name: Critical Condition
rules: Players with 5–10 health take 1 damage. Players below 5 health take 2 damage.

name: Black Market
rules: You may exchange once using the table’s Black Market configuration. Discard unkept cards.
quip: Everything is available. Nothing is free.
